fusions.name: Flung Spicule
fusions.desc: Flings a reef spicule that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds, healing doing less for it. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Every Polyp Fires
fusions.desc: Every stinging cell on you fires at once, dealing 26 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Staghorn Thicket
fusions.desc: Grows a wall of branching spines 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Reef Rash
fusions.desc: 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
